title: Bolus calc : if pump gives error, the carbs are not registered
symptom: When using the bolus calculator, if the pump gives an error (e.g., daily insulin limit reached) during insulin delivery, the carbs entered are not registered, even though some insulin may have been delivered and registered.
cause: The behavior is by design to prevent double carbs entry on a second try.
fix: No fix provided; the behavior is by design. The user is informed via a message to check insulin and carbs.
evidence_quote: this is by design to prevent double carbs entry on 2nd try
